title: INT8 weight-only profile CI integration and deterministic calibration harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add first-class support for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ) into the runtime's calibration harness and CI regression suites. Scope: profile ingestion, metadata (bitwidth, group size, per-channel flags), deterministic calibration orchestration, standardized evaluation prompts, baseline storage, CI definitions (PR gate + nightly), and dashboarding for regression detection. Out of scope: FP8 rollout and quantized training flows. Motivation: enable cost-efficient INT8 variants behind a controlled rollout after ensuring accuracy stability across our core evaluation sets and customer workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness loads GPTQ and AWQ artifact bundles and emits deterministic outputs for a fixed RNG seed and prompt set
CI job runs calibration + evaluation end-to-end within limits (<= 4 hours per nightly model run) and artifacts are uploaded to stable storage
Per-model metric deltas vs FP16 baseline are computed and recorded; any regression > 1.5% absolute on primary metrics fails the CI gate
Dashboard panels show baseline vs current deltas and regression alerts are wired to #quant-regressions and PagerDuty
Confluence doc updated with profile schema, upload recipe, rollback steps, and owner contact
test_plan: Unit tests for profile JSON schema and loader (edge cases: missing per-channel flags, unexpected group sizes)
Integration test: apply GPTQ artifact for small model on CI runner with fixed seed and compare hash of token outputs to golden artifact
Regression suite: run instruction-following + RAG QA prompt sets, compute EM/F1 and n-gram metrics, compare to FP16 baseline
Nightly job: sweep selected production models and store daily deltas to S3 for trend analysis
notes: Early experiments (ENG-5922) show AWQ group size 64 with per-channel scaling produces best latency/cost without >2% accuracy drop on average prompts
Determinism requires fixing CUDA/cuBLAS algorithm selection and RNG seeds in the runtime; coordinate with infra team
Golden artifacts stored at s3://redwood-quant/baselines/int8/ with version tags; CI should fetch specific tag refs
Potential flakiness if host CPU BLAS or MKL versions differ between runners; recommend Dockerized runner image with pinned libs
